items.text: Character creator looks like an out of season April Fools (bad) joke. I should probably wear my glasses while making purchases, because it is actually featured on the store page, mea culpa.
items.text_zh: 角色创建器看起来像是一个过季的愚人节（糟糕的）玩笑。我买东西时大概应该戴上眼镜，因为它实际上就展示在商店页面上，是我的错。
